title: Clean a messy customer CSV
prompt: customers.csv is messy. Write a cleaned copy to customers_clean.csv: trim names, collapse repeated spaces and convert them to Title Case; lowercase emails; remove duplicates by email, keeping the row with the earliest signup; normalise signup_date to ISO YYYY-MM-DD (the input mixes YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY and '5 Jan 2026'); sort by signup_date, then email. Keep the header name,email,signup_date.
